entities.name: Héctor Rondón
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Héctor Luis Rondón is a Venezuelan former professional baseball pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Chicago Cubs, Houston Astros, and Arizona Diamondbacks. Rondón signed as an international free agent with the Cleveland Indians in 2004.
